intro: A Last Request begins upon discovering the corpse of a fallen peacekeeper in the field. Clutched in the dead guard's hands is a bloodstained note containing vital clues about his final moments. Reading his dying words offers the only way to carry out his unfinished duty and bring closure to his fate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news from the western watch?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.
I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
